focused_result.scope_limit: Focused 15-case evidence only; this is not final quality, five-project Gate A or exact-head CI.

expected_behavior: Verbose audit emits the fixed relative-source diagnostic without untrusted exception content.
Within the file-count budget, default stderr remains empty; repeated complete JSON agrees except generated_at and original input bytes remain identical.
A real 501-file candidate view with one selected parser failure reports parsed 499, selected 500, omitted 1; the default coverage summary appears once.
groups.label: audit-diagnostics-group1

expected_behavior: An independent observed torch WARNING retains its evidence and triggers the warning threshold while remaining below the critical threshold.
A later normal vllm source retains inference high confidence and the positive mismatch INFO finding.
The existing declared-profile-absence branch emits SKIPPED/INFO for a parser gap even under a CRITICAL override; completed parsing restores its existing CRITICAL absence outcome.
groups.label: audit-branches-group2

expected_behavior: init --list-tasks returns the literal demo_task inventory without writing any input or owned artifact.
init retains normal inference/evaluation signals, the HF model candidate and explicitly selected task; only its three owned artifacts are added.
export completes and repeats identical Markdown under identical input facts; every original input byte and existing diagnostic visibility remain unchanged.
groups.label: cli-consumers-group3-final

expected_behavior: The native 80006-byte, 10000-term input is probed by an independent interpreter process and then audited through an independent public console process.
A normal 100-term expression remains fully parsed, with all six selected findings PASS.
The existing SyntaxError diagnostic and both aggregate parse gaps remain exact.
Parser MemoryError/RuntimeError and tree-walk RecursionError remain errors rather than being silently skipped.
groups.label: native-and-catch-scope-group4

native_proof.conditional_skip: A native probe that parses successfully, a hard process failure, or a 30-second timeout explicitly skips this native proof; none counts as a recovery PASS.
native_proof.isolation: Both native parse probe and real console run in independent processes; the parent test process never parses the complex input.
native_proof.limits: The fix does not protect against native crashes, memory exhaustion, parser hangs or independent framework parsers.
native_proof.observed_case: 80006 bytes, 10000 terms, catchable native ast.parse RecursionError.
native_proof.observed_focused_outcome: PASS without skip on the observed interpreter.
native_proof.other_interpreters: No native PASS is claimed for another interpreter or version. It must establish its own catchable-RecursionError premise.
native_proof.portable_target_branch: External ast.parse injection tests exercise the target RecursionError branch independently of native parser thresholds.
native_proof.replay_qualification: Console completion with fail-on never is not proof of a clean experiment; the focused native test separately uses a committed fixture and the warning threshold.
